subject.title: fix(qqbot): surface terminal reply-session conflict failures

question: Should the proven QQBot terminal-notice fix land first with its strict local classifier, or wait for the typed Plugin SDK classifier in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109902?
rationale: Both sequences are technically viable, but repository extension policy prefers a shared typed seam while the urgent user-facing message-loss fix already has strong live proof; choosing the temporary boundary is an owner decision.

options.title: Land QQBot first
options.body: Merge the narrow proven behavior fix now and require the open Plugin SDK PR to migrate QQBot before its own merge.

options.title: Use SDK seam first
options.body: Pause this PR until the shared classifier is approved, then rebase QQBot terminal handling onto that exported predicate.

options.title: Fold into one change
options.body: Combine terminal handling and the shared classifier migration into one owner-reviewed cross-channel PR.

recommendation.title: Land QQBot first
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow proven behavior fix now and require the open Plugin SDK PR to migrate QQBot before its own merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the affected QQBot gateway and delivery architecture, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the temporary local-boundary choice.
